name: Altitude
mood: Midnight financial editorial: carbon canvas, bone serif headlines, thin gray surface layers, terminal details, alpine imagery, and a single blue accent.

carbonCanvas.role: Primary page background and dominant dark surface.

obsidian.role: Deepest surface layer for footers, contrast wells, and dark recesses.

graphiteCard.role: Card, input, terminal, and contained panel surface.

slateElevated.role: Hover rows, secondary panels, dividers, and raised surfaces.

ironPeak.role: Top dark tier for popovers, active rows, and selected controls.

bone.role: Primary text, major labels, and bright hairline details.

fog.role: Muted helper text, icon strokes, captions, and disabled labels.

smoke.role: Low-emphasis text, subtle dividers, and quiet badge fills.

pureWhite.role: Maximum contrast details and light contrast panels.

voltageBlue.role: Only saturated accent for links, focus rings, active states, and terminal highlights.

midNavy.role: Subtle blue depth for icons, thin decorative marks, and restrained heading tints.

fallbacks.display: Source Serif Pro, Lora, Crimson Text, serif
fallbacks.code: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

rules: Use Libre Baskerville only for display and section headlines.
Use Inter for all functional UI and body copy.
Use Fira Code only for code, terminal, command, and data-identifier contexts.
Keep serif headlines at 400 or 500 weight.
Use positive tracking on tiny uppercase labels.

components.name: Neutral Button
components.recipe: Transparent or Graphite Card surface, 1px Slate border, 4px radius, Inter 14px/600, Bone text, compact padding.

components.name: Serif Section Header
components.recipe: Libre Baskerville 36-72px, weight 400, tight tracking, Bone text on dark backgrounds with Fog Inter support copy.

components.name: Workflow Tile
components.recipe: Light stone or Pure White surface, 8px radius, 12-24px padding, Ash border, centered outline icon, dark Inter label.

components.name: Terminal Window
components.recipe: Graphite Card background, 8px radius, 1px Slate Elevated border, compact chrome, and Fira Code content.

components.name: Data Table Row
components.recipe: Inter 13px, Bone text, Slate row separators, alternating transparent and Slate Elevated row backgrounds.

components.name: Small Badge
components.recipe: 4px radius, tiny Inter uppercase text with positive tracking, neutral fill; use Voltage Blue only for active state.

do: Use the stepped dark gray surface stack as the foundation.
Use Libre Baskerville for page-level statements only.
Use Inter for body and functional UI.
Use Fira Code for terminal and data identifiers.
Reserve Voltage Blue for functional accents.
Use thin borders and restrained shadows.
Use mountain landscapes, ridge line art, and product terminal screenshots as imagery.
dont: Do not introduce extra accent colors.
Do not use bold serif headlines.
Do not use serif text for body or UI controls.
Do not use gradient meshes, glowing orbs, or glass effects.
Do not make all content sections black.
Do not turn badges and buttons into large pills.

imagery.style: Muted alpine landscape photography, thin mountain ridge line art, and terminal/product screenshots.
rules: Use mountain or summit imagery in blue-gray tones.
Use thin 1px line art as a restrained graphic motif.
Avoid abstract gradient art and 3D decorative objects.

layout.structure: Centered 1200px max-width dark page with simple top nav, editorial hero, dark product sections, and one light workflow grid interruption.
layout.navigation: Simple 64px top bar with wordmark, centered links, and right-side login or action.
